create_incremental_strategy: create an IncrementalStrategy instance with a specified number of new classes per task
run_new_task: run new_task on an IncrementalStrategy to generate a task with new compatible concepts
test_incremental_strategy: test the IncrementalStrategy class to verify it creates tasks with the correct number of new classes
review_incremental_strategy: review the IncrementalStrategy class and its new_task method for incremental continual learning task creation
refactor_new_task: refactor the new_task method in IncrementalStrategy to support custom concept compatibility logic
